Database Performance & Capacity: Find and fix slow queries, lock contention, replication lag, and connection pool problems using Performance Insights and Enhanced Monitoring, and plan capacity before growth hits limits. Database Change Management: Plan and run schema changes, engine upgrades, and data moves with minimal downtime, using AWS DMS or native tooling. Disaster Recovery & Resilience Testing: Plan and run regular DR exercises and tabletop exercises across AWS and Google Cloud, including restore tests, failover drills, and validation of recovery time (RTO) and recovery point (RPO) objectives, and turn the findings into runbook and architecture improvements. CI/CD & GitOps: Build and manage pipelines in GitHub Actions or AWS CodePipeline, and deploy applications through ArgoCD. Monitoring & Troubleshooting: Set up observability with ELK, Grafana, Loki, Prometheus, or Amazon CloudWatch to track database and platform health, manage logs, and resolve production incidents. On-Call Coverage: Participate in a rotating on-call schedule with the team, respond to production alerts and database incidents during your shift, and follow up with postmortems and runbook updates. AIOps & AI-Assisted Operations: Use AIOps and AI tooling to catch database anomalies and slow-query regressions early, forecast capacity, cut alert noise, and speed up incident triage, so our data layer stays reliable as it scales. Documentation: Document architecture, database standards, and runbooks in Confluence. Hands-on infrastructure as code experience with Terraform, in a team setting with code review. Comfort scripting in Python or Bash to automate database and platform operations. Hands-on observability experience with tools like ELK, Grafana, Loki, and Prometheus. Experience troubleshooting production incidents and writing clear postmortems. Experience planning and running disaster recovery exercises, including tabletop exercises. Willingness to participate in an on-call rotation. Preferred Qualifications Production experience with ArgoCD and GitOps workflows. Experience with AWS CloudFormation or AWS CDK. AWS Certified Database Specialty, Solutions Architect Professional, or similar certification. Experience with Datadog. Experience with Rubrik for backup and recovery. Hands-on experience with Google Cloud, including Cloud SQL, GKE, and BigQuery. Experience with AIOps or AI-assisted tooling for anomaly detection, incident triage, or operational metrics. Experience in healthcare or another regulated environment.
